# Filtered Array

Source: [wiki article 4610](../archive/4610.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Filtered Array](../../api/values/filtered-array.md).

<a id="wiki-4610-n1"></a>

- Filtered Array returns a new array without changing the original; its condition runs for each element with Current Array Element bound to that element.

<a id="wiki-4610-n2"></a>

- Filter condition need not depend on the current element: an all-or-none visibility filter can hide/show a long-lived effect without destroying/recreating it.
